Criterion 3 (rivals ruled out) is confirmed - verified eviction occurred after drift onset and deploy occurred after first double-reserve. Criterion 2 (log traces) fails: while the double-reserve mechanism is real, the trace table presents fabricated line numbers violating the evidence standard.

(2) Six requests traced with line numbers verified: r-0035 (2 reserves, 1 confirm), r-0039 (2 reserves, 1 confirm), r-0012 (2 reserves, 1 confirm), r-0053 (3 reserves, 1 confirm) - all show multiple inventory reserves under computed per-attempt keys with single orders confirmation.
